title: Docking and Molecular Dynamics Studies on Anticancer Activities of Flavonoids as Inhibitors of CDK2 and CDK9.
authors: Sony, A S; Suresh, M Xavier
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和MD模拟筛选黄酮类化合物对CDK2/CDK9激酶的抑制活性，属于药物-蛋白互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Flavonoids express a wide range of medicinal properties, our study presented results on the anticancer activity of selected compounds using in silico studies. OBJECTIVE: In this article, in silico studies were carried out to find promising anticancer lead among selected flavonoid compounds. METHODS: Here, we carried out molecular docking and MD simulation for anticancer screening of flavonoid derivatives against CDK2 and CDK9 proteins. RESULTS: Among the compounds under investigation, Flavone and Recoflavone had the lowest binding energy against CDK2/CDK9 targets using docking studies and MD simulations. CONCLUSION: We can conclude that Flavone and Recoflavone are promising anticancer lead compounds in the development of new anticancer drugs.
abstract_zh: 背景：黄酮类化合物表现出广泛的药用特性，我们的研究通过计算机模拟（in silico）研究展示了所选化合物的抗癌活性。目的：本文进行了计算机模拟研究，以在所选黄酮类化合物中寻找有前景的抗癌先导物。方法：在此，我们进行了分子对接（molecular docking）和分子动力学（MD）模拟，以筛选黄酮衍生物对CDK2和CDK9蛋白的抗癌活性。结果：在所研究的化合物中，Flavone和Recoflavone通过对接研究和MD模拟对CDK2/CDK9靶点表现出最低的结合能。结论：我们可以得出结论，Flavone和Recoflavone是开发新型抗癌药物中有前景的抗癌先导化合物。
